Bukannya menjadi pengarah di syarikat keluarganya, Kevin sebaliknya terpaksa bekerja sebagai kakitangan pembersihan (housekeeping). Disebabkan kemelut tersebut, Kevin sebenarnya telah bertemu dengan Alana yang berjaya membuatkannya jatuh cinta. Namun sekali lagi, kenyataan tidaklah seindah impian, Kevin juga harus berjuang demi mengejar cintanya.

programme.title: Aku Bukan Geisha

programme.title: Article 247
programme.desc: Drama ini mengisahkan tentang Mary Jane yang terselamat daripada cubaan pembunuhan oleh suaminya sendiri, namun penyerangnya terlepas hukuman disebabkan perlindungan di bawah akta Artikel 247 Kod Jenayah Filipina. Beberapa tahun kemudian, merekadipertemukan semula, membuka kisah penuh dendam, keadilan, dan rahsia masa lalu yang mengubah hidup semua pihak.

programme.title: My Love In The Countryside
programme.desc: Saisamorn Suaisamoe, merupakan seorang artis atas dari keluarga kaya, namun dia tiada pengalaman dalam menjiwai watak yang beremosi cinta. Oleh itu, dia bercadang pergi ke desa Phetchaburi agar boleh mempunyai pengalaman tentang cinta. Di sana Saisamorn tinggal di rumah Marasri yang terkenal dengan mulut celuparnya. Dia berkenalan dengan Mana. Mana mengajar Saisamorn cara kehidupan didesa dimana pada mulanya menjadi perkara yang sangat sukar untuk Saisamorn.

programme.title: Yashoda

Dia terpaksa memperhentikan pelajarannya dan mula menceburi diri dalam bidang pertanian, peninggalan kerjaya ayahnya. Akhirnya, dia berjaya dalam bidang pertaniandan membuktikan kepada yang lain bahawa bidang pertanian turut boleh menghasilkan pendapatan yang lumayan.

programme.title: Jangan Pernah Lupakan Aku
programme.desc: Jeremy menyatakan hasrat untuk menikahi Ariana kepada Tok Wan dan dia berusaha mendalami selok belok ilmu agama. Tok Wan meminta Johan memberi tunjuk ajar kepada Jeremy. Ketika Jeremy sedang berada di rumah Joe untuk mendalami selok belok agama Jasmin datang dan sengaja mengoda Jeremy.

programme.desc: Kisah percintaan tragis antara seorang bangsawan misteri, Lee Jang-hyun, dan seorang wanita bangsawan berani, Yoo Gil-chae, yang berlaku ketika zaman penjajahan Dinasti Qing di Korea. Dalam suasana perang dan huru-hara, cinta mereka diuji denganperpisahan, pengorbanan dan penderitaan. Jang-hyun yang menyembunyikan kisah silamnya, mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta dengan Gil-chae. Sementara itu, Gil-chae belajar tentang erti cinta sebenar dan ketabahan melalui liku-liku yang menyayat hati.

programme.title: I Love 70
programme.desc: Sundram sudah berusia 70 tahun dan mula menunjukkan masalah daya ingatan yang semakin merosot. Isterinya Meera dan anak lelakinya Mugun cuba membantu Sundram menghadapi masalah kesihatannya.

programme.title: Gotham II
programme.desc: Gordon berjaya membuktikan bahawa Nygma ialah dalang pemfitnahan terhadapnya. Nygma ditangkap dan dihantar ke Arkham.

programme.title: Piper
programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.

programme.desc: On a stormy night near Hamelin, Matty (10) is driven to suicide by the hypnotic music of a phantom Piper that only his distressed mother can distinguish, causing her to flee the city. Soon after, American emigres Liz and her daughter Amy land in Germany. Liz takes on the history teacher position vacated by Kerry at Hamelins International School. The annual Pied Piper Pageant is celebrated the day after their arrival. Liz revels in it, but Amy finds it macabre - until she meets the handsome Weser Street magician, Luca, when Liz is not looking. Liz becomes plagued by visions of rat infestations, while Amy hallucinates fleas swarming in her bed. Yet real fleabites appear on Amy's body, one by one her fingertips bleed at night from nasty wounds, believing them to be caused by rats. Liz and Amy individually learn the truth behind the legend of The Piper who is a cruel and vengeful minister of harsh justice, punishing adults who get away with crimes by taking away their children. No longer a legend of yesteryear, The Piper is real with his judging eyes set on Liz and her dark secret.
